subject: types: remove param `explicitTz` from `types.ParseTime` (#48574)
summary: Reviewed db2e239496d81614f8c6bbb298bbaa22007181d3 vs its first parent, focusing on executor/expression/sessionctx changes. `pkg/executor/brie.go` and `pkg/sessionctx/variable/varsutil.go` are mechanical updates removing the deleted `explicitTz` argument (previously always `nil`). The only semantics-sensitive change in-scope is `pkg/expression/helper.go:GetTimeValue`, which now applies an explicit timezone by cloning the statement `TypeCtx` via `WithLocation(explicitTz)` before calling `types.ParseTime`/`types.ParseTimeFromNum`, consistent with the new ParseTime contract (timezone now comes solely from `ctx.Location()`). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in time parsing semantics, session/txn timestamp parsing, or cast/builtin runtime behavior.
